_doc: Per-module dispositions of the excursions of the decisive frame run (st-live-frame-r8) and the exact remainders. A declaration gap is an excursion against the footprint the check used (footprints/NN.json or correspondence/correspondence.json) where the written node is under the action's keys (key level held) but the footprint omits the store: reported for the footprint's owner, never widened here. A finding is an excursion the product's own contract forbids.
